summary: The Next.js chat handler option `temperature` accepts `null`, which sends no `temperature` to the model (also none to memory summary calls).
howTo: Set `temperature: null` for models that reject it (reasoning models) instead of stripping it from the request. Custom `streamHandler`s still receive `ctx.temperature` as `number | undefined`: `undefined` when the option is `null`, so passing it on to `streamText` keeps compiling.
